name: New Year Celebrations!
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Level 60 instead of 70. Requires level 1 instead of 60. Pays 9s instead of 0. From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Stormwind is holding a celebration for the new year!  All day long today you can get free booze, and at night they'll put on a firework show!  It should be pretty nice... but Booty Bay is also having a party today; I bet it'll be even better!

Well anyway, Innkeeper Allison in Stormwind needs a supply of Smoky Wood Pasture fare to help feed all the party goers.  Can you do me a favor and deliver it!

Thanks, adventurer!  Innkeeper Allison is in the Gilded Rose, in the Trade District of Stormwind.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Smokywood Supplies to Innkeeper Allison in Stormwind.
narrative.offerRewardText: Oh, my Smokywood supplies! Splendid! I'll need these to feed all the people in town for the celebration!Thank you, adventurer. Please take this as payment, and don't forget to drink and dance with the revelers outside!
narrative.requestItemsText: Greetings! Are you here for the party! Or perhaps you just need to rest those weary feet of yours...
